description: SwiftUI iOS prayer-lock alarm that compiles on iPhone 17 Pro sim.

userStories.title: Xcode project builds
userStories.description: Miqat.xcodeproj, SwiftUI app target. Must xcodebuild on iOS Simulator. No missing types. No fake SwiftData preview inits. No unknown next/font-style mistakes. SealCameraController must exist if referenced. AVSpeechSynthesisDelegate needs import AVFAudio.
acceptanceCriteria: xcodebuild -scheme Miqat -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=26.5' build exits 0
userStories.verify: xcodebuild -project Miqat.xcodeproj -scheme Miqat -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro,OS=26.5' -derivedDataPath /tmp/miqat-ralph-dd build
